title: CodeHivemind: do models generate the same insecure code patterns?

original_idea.body: ~50 coding tasks with secure/insecure choice; do code models converge on the same insecure pattern (static checks).

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Independent-friendly, public code models, supply-chain scrutiny.
